services.desc: Visit The Confluence Cultural Centre and immerse yourself in stories about Indigenous culture, Treaty 7, Fort Calgary, and the founding and early stages of the city of Calgary. The cultural centre is currently undergoing a major construction project to prepare the space for new exhibits, and our main exhibits are available for viewing throughout this time. Kípaitápiiyssinnooni (ghee-BAHT-ah-BEE-see-noon) means Our Way of Life in Blackfoot. This new exhibit, curated by Niitsitapi artist Star Crop Eared Wolf of the Kainai Nation, invites visitors into an immersive cultural experience rooted in Blackfoot ways of knowing, being, and belonging.
